scope: Full free-body U contact pilots, bounded fixed-stencil wrench certificates, exact raw-tensor native replay and pad strain limitations

y.scope: Audit a constant-load contact hold and replay its resolved nodal loads natively.
y.limitations: One additional constant-load increment probes the displacement-smoothed friction history; it is not temporal or spatial convergence. Direct nodal replay isolates elastic recovery. Finite-footprint/load-model replay, rigid contact feedback, spatial/regularization tails and actual Franka matching remain required.

fixed_stencil_support.limitations: The contact geometry and existing stencil are fixed. Positive feasibility supplies possible static wrenches, not deformation/contact convergence. Negative certificates exclude only this fixed stencil's admissible force distributions; additional contacts, deformation and pose changes can alter support. Force/moment checks use the linear FEM reference rigid modes, with two x-free guided backplates. No general grasp infeasibility or resolved-contact acceptance is claimed.
